scope: Three preselected sources; sampled DR1 pixels and DR1+QR3 metadata. Not exhaustive.
limitations: Not an all-sky or statistically representative sample.
No calibrated SPHEREx spectrum extracted; no source classification or discovery made.
NEOWISE screening uses stated heuristic thresholds; rejection does not establish absence of astrophysical variability.
Source association, crowding, saturation corrections, and independent controls remain unvalidated.
Eleven cutout requests returned HTTP 503; missing downloads were not treated as missing sky coverage.
Competitor documentation and selected source code reviewed; competitor scientific performance not independently tested.
independent_check: Spectral WCS wavelength for sample_cutout.fits matched direct bilinear interpolation of WCS-WAVE calibration table to <1e-6 micron.
